mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 950K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 950K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, a tightening labor market drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as firms increase investments.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as firms face increased costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust growth in real disposable income (RSAFS) above 4% YoY drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as consumers increase discretionary spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS growth > 4% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to less than 50K in a month, a weakening labor market drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals robust aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as firms increase investments.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
